visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a futuristic retail interior featuring white, abstract, curvilinear display islands showcasing various avant-garde headwear. (2) The scene shifts to the exterior of a modern gray building with the brand name ATIISSU in bold silver lettering; a female character in a brown hoodie and matching pants is seen walking toward the glass entrance. (3) Inside, the first floor displays a stark industrial aesthetic with a large, crumpled silver metallic sculpture running through the space; various caps and knit hats are arranged on white tiered shelves. (4) Close-up shots highlight specific hat designs, including black beanies with pointed animal-ear structures and grey knit caps with goggles. (5) The main character is seen in mirror selfies, trying on a grey beanie with long tassel-like strings while wearing black-rimmed sunglasses; she smiles and poses. (6) On the second floor, the walls are made of white perforated metal, displaying more diverse hat styles like bucket hats and denim-inspired headwear. (7) Detailed close-ups show the intricate textures of the fabrics, including beaded embroidery and wavy knit patterns. (8) At the checkout counter, a male staff member in a black jacket interacts with the main character, handing her a small receipt and a circular black-and-white buzzer tag. (9) The final shots include a street sign and a wide view of the store's interior layout.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, energetic female voice speaking in Mandarin, set against a steady, mid-tempo electronic pop BGM with a clear 4/4 beat. The narrator's tone is warm and welcoming, establishing a conversational vlog style. (2) As she discusses entering the store, the BGM maintains its upbeat energy, featuring clean synth stabs and a driving bassline. The voice remains consistent in pitch and moderate in speed, with very low ambient room tone. (3) At the point where she mentions an item is sold out, there is a slight shift to a mock-sad inflection before returning to high-arousal excitement about the store's second floor. (4) The narrative concludes with the same high-energy tone as she gives a recommendation, accompanied by a subtle whoosh SFX during a visual transition, before the music fades out alongside her speech.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle recommendation vlog focusing on the new hat brand ATIISSU by Gentle Monster in Seoul. It combines a visually striking tour of the store's avant-garde interior with the creator's personal trial of products to build interest and social proof for the brand.
